verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a SaaS code-review service that ingests customer code, so the axis applies. The privacy page only covers no third-party model training and an option to block AI features per workspace (cubic-supp-1), plus SOC 2 Type 1 (cubic-supp-2). Nothing in the pack describes retention periods, deletion requests, or user controls over stored code, memories or review data.
